questions.question: In a psalm of Asaph, God says that when the earth and all its dwellers quake, what does He do?
A psalm says lifting up a person does not come from the east, the west or the desert. Where does it come from?

answers.text: From the kings of the earth

questions.question: In a psalm of Asaph, the LORD holds a cup of foaming wine. Who drinks it down to the dregs?

answers.text: All the wicked of the earth
All the priests of the land
All the elders of the city

questions.question: In a psalm of Asaph, what does God say will happen to the horns of the wicked and the horns of the righteous?

answers.text: Wicked horns cut off and righteous horns exalted
Wicked horns exalted and righteous horns cut off
Both kinds of horns cut off alike
